summary: Whether draping the couches or Telmachus sparing Goddesses of Wisdom from mansplaining shared stories have always suggested putting out a welcoming chair. #poetryport
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Whether draping the couches
or Telmachus sparing
Goddesses of Wisdom
from mansplaining
shared stories have
always suggested
putting out a
welcoming chair.
#poetryport
